archetypes.name: dyn-stall-dedup
archetypes.rationale: Tier A marker placement interacts with the issue parser and dedup lookup.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed stall recovery issue-input composition path. Verify the public dedup marker now appears after the title and remains in the body parsed by issue_create.parse_issue_input. Check that Tier B chat-print behavior, redaction order, and the record-failure marker Path parameter remain unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
